tools.name: get_language_options
tools.description: List Poly-Glot's 38 supported UI, input, and AI output languages. Use to verify language availability before multilingual work. Optionally select uiLanguage to localize labels. Returns language records and localization metadata. Read-only, with no send or trial activation.

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Read the current account's access state, trial timing, subscription entitlement locks and subscription pricing. Use before gated tools or when asked about remaining access. This read-only operation never starts a trial or a charge. Eligible introductory trials begin only after an Apple subscription

tools.name: open_workspace
tools.description: Open the embedded Poly-Glot prompt workspace and template browser, optionally prefiltered by a query and translated via uiLanguage. Returns the unlocked template catalog only for verified subscribers or valid legacy trials, plus entitlement and localization. An unsubscribed account receives no catal

tools.name: search_templates
tools.description: Search Poly-Glot's template catalog by keywords and goal, optionally filtered to free or Pro results. Use before get_template or build_prompt when the exact name is unknown. Expired accounts see locked Pro template cards. Selecting one returns a paywall, not Pro fields or prompt text. Searching is r

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Retrieve a named template's fields and entitled prompt body. Use search_templates first to find the exact name; inaccessible templates return a paywall view without Pro fields or prompt content after the trial. Returns template, entitlement and localization data. Reading a template alone neither sta

tools.name: build_prompt
tools.description: Fill a named Poly-Glot template with field values and requested input/output languages, producing a finished prompt. Use get_template to inspect needed fields first. This is a subscription-gated Send. Eligible users must authorize a three-day Pro introductory trial through Apple's native subscriptio

tools.name: prepare_compare
tools.description: Prepare the same canonical prompt for two to eight selected AI providers using a raw prompt or accessible template. Returns provider destinations, prompt and usage instructions without calling third-party models. This is a subscription-gated Send; Compare Mode requires a verified Apple subscription

tools.name: get_custom_model_capabilities
tools.description: Explain the supported Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) adapters, credential handling, HTTPS and SSRF restrictions, and inability of a public remote MCP server to connect directly to localhost. Use before configuring a custom model. Returns capability metadata without contacting a model, starting a trial,

tools.name: validate_custom_model
tools.description: Validate the HTTPS URL and adapter configuration for an external custom model. For OpenAI-compatible mode provide baseUrl; for custom REST use endpoint. Set probe=true only when an actual minimal request to the external provider is intended. Returns validation or probe status; credentials are transi

tools.name: run_custom_model
tools.description: Run a user-supplied prompt against a developer-provided OpenAI-compatible or custom REST HTTPS model endpoint. Use validate_custom_model to test URL and adapter settings before sending. Returns model-generated text, model name, optional usage, and account state. Requires active trial or Pro and tran

tools.name: prepare_custom_compare
tools.description: Prepare a canonical prompt and instructions for comparing at least two targets, including one to five custom BYOM models and optional supported built-in AI providers. API keys must not appear in the comparison plan; use run_custom_model to execute custom targets separately. Returns comparison target

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Convert audio to transcript text for Poly-Glot workflows. Use for supplied speech recordings, not for translating text. Provide exactly one source: a publicly reachable HTTPS audioUrl or base64-encoded audioBase64 (without a data-URL prefix). For base64 audio, supply mimeType and filename when known

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Identify the primary language of a nonempty text snippet and map it to one of Poly-Glot's 38 supported language codes. Use when the source language is unknown before choosing an interface, output language, or translation workflow. Provide natural-language text in the text parameter (for example, '¿D

tools.name: translate_text
tools.description: Translate supplied text into one of Poly-Glot's 38 supported languages while aiming to preserve meaning, names, formatting, code, and URLs. Use for translation rather than cultural adaptation; use localize_text when audience, tone, or regional conventions must change. Specify required targetLanguage

tools.name: localize_text
tools.description: Adapt supplied text for a target language and audience, including culturally appropriate phrasing, tone, and regional conventions rather than literal translation.
